comment: Preselected PICK_ONE menus whose C callers act only on select_menu() > 0. handler_menustyle(): '-' clears the preselected row and Return commits nothing (n == 0), so the style is unchanged and the verbose 'is still' line follows. handler_msg_window(): the preselected row's own selector toggles it off (n == 0). handler_sortloot(): ESC (n == -1). handler_whatis_coord() and handler_whatis_filter(): Return keeps the preselected row (n == 1), then picking another row returns both rows and the C tie-break takes the new one. With query_menu set, cmd.c yn_function_menu() asks #pray's confirmation as a menu: the default row's own selector (n == 0) and then Return (n == 1) both answer the default 'n'. A last #optionsfull shows the resulting values on its fifth and sixth pages. Seed, datetime, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
